individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A contains only fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, Merge), no averaged plot is shown.
The two bar charts (JC-1 Green/Red ratio and anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) show only mean bars with error bars; no individual data points are overlaid.
Panel C is a western blot image with no quantification plot.
The SDH and COX signal intensity bar charts show only group means with error bars (N indicated inside bars); individual data points are not plotted.

The FACS panels are frequency histograms (cell number vs TMRM intensity) showing three independent replicate distributions directly, not bar charts of averages, so overlaying individual points is not applicable.
